echo.title: The fruit of the Spirit

elements.label: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy and peace
It also includes patience, kindness and goodness
Faith, meekness and self-control belong to it
Against such there is no law
Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh
If we live by the Spirit, let us also walk by the Spirit

echo.heart: Which fruit of the Spirit is growing in you, and which needs more of God's work?
echo.mission: Choose one fruit of the Spirit to practise this week, and tell a friend how you tried.

echo.title: Saved by grace

elements.label: You are saved by grace through faith
This salvation is not of yourselves
It is the gift of God
Not of works, so that no one can boast
We are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works

echo.heart: How does knowing that salvation is a gift change the way you see your own efforts?
echo.mission: Thank God this week for one thing he has given you that you did not earn.

echo.title: Rejoice and do not be anxious

elements.label: Rejoice in the Lord always
Let your gentleness be known to everyone
Be careful for nothing
Make your requests known by prayer and thanksgiving
The peace of God passes all understanding

echo.heart: What worry is God asking you to bring to him in prayer today?
echo.mission: Write down three things you are thankful for each day this week, and pray with thanksgiving.

echo.title: Faith described

elements.label: Faith is the substance of things hoped for
By faith Abel offered a better sacrifice than Cain
Enoch was taken away and did not see death
By faith Noah prepared an ark
Without faith it is impossible to please God
God is a rewarder of those who seek him

echo.heart: What is one thing you are trusting God for that you cannot yet see?
echo.mission: Take one faithful step this week towards something you believe God has asked you to do.

echo.title: Trials and wisdom

elements.label: Count it all joy when you meet trials
The trying of your faith works patience
If you lack wisdom, ask God, who gives liberally
Ask in faith, with no doubting
A double-minded man is unstable in all his ways

echo.heart: What trial is teaching you patience or wisdom right now?
echo.mission: Ask God this week for wisdom about one decision, and share your prayer with a friend.

echo.title: A chosen people

elements.label: You are a chosen generation
You are a royal priesthood
You are a holy nation and a peculiar people
You should show forth the praises of God
You who were not a people are now the people of God

echo.heart: What does it mean to you to be called out of darkness into God's light?
echo.mission: Tell someone this week about God's mercy in your life, using 1 Peter 2:9.

chars.name: Abel
chars.info: Abel offered a righteous sacrifice by faith, and his brother Cain killed him.
clues: I was a keeper of sheep.
I brought an offering from the firstborn of my flock.
God accepted my offering by faith.
My brother Cain killed me in the field. Who am I?

chars.name: Noah
chars.info: Noah built an ark by faith and was saved from the flood with his family.
clues: God told me to build an ark.
I was a righteous man in my generation.
I took my family and the animals into the ark.
God set a rainbow as the sign of his covenant. Who am I?

chars.name: James the Just
chars.info: James, the brother of the Lord, led the church in Jerusalem and taught that faith shows itself in works.
clues: I was a brother of the Lord.
I spoke at the council in Jerusalem.
I taught that faith without works is dead.
I wrote a letter to the twelve tribes. Who am I?

chars.name: Elisabeth
chars.info: Elisabeth was the mother of John the Baptist, and was filled with the Holy Ghost when Mary visited.
clues: I was the wife of the priest Zacharias.
I was old and had no children.
I gave birth to a son who prepared the way of the Lord.
When my cousin Mary greeted me, I was filled with the Holy Ghost. Who am I?
